title: GPU instance-pool Terraform module: unified ASG + Karpenter provisioner bridge for Private VPC
creator: Anjali Rao
description: Build a composable Terraform module that provisions and manages GPU instance pools in Private VPCs and provides a consistent interface for both ASG-based and Karpenter-based autoscaling. The module should enable safe OS/driver upgrades, mixed instance policies (spot/on-demand fallback), node lifecycle hooks (cordon/drain/upgrade), explicit health checks (kernel/driver/firmware), and observability outputs for Redwood Private. This aims to reduce bespoke per-customer scripts, improve upgrade safety, and provide clear rollback/fallback behavior when capacity is constrained.
acceptance_criteria: Module exposes single configuration to choose mode: 'asg' or 'karpenter' and validates incompatible flags
Automated driver install path via SSM/daemonset with retry and signature verification; documented and enabled by default for private deployments
Upgrade rollout supports canary subset (configurable percent or explicit node selectors) with cordon -> drain -> replace pattern and automatic rollback on failing health probes
Built-in healthcheck Lambda/agent that performs node-level driver, CUDA, and NVML sanity checks and reports to a Prometheus pushgateway or Redwood control plane endpoint
Mixed instance policy for ASG and Karpenter provisioner profiles with spot-to-on-demand fallback and sizing safeguards to avoid capacity loss
Outputs include capacity targets, auto-scaling hooks ARN(s), nodegroup labels/taints to use in pod specs, and diagnostics URL for the Private console
Module passes CI smoke tests that create a minimal Private VPC cluster, launches a 2-node GPU pool, runs a sample inference container, and validates < 150ms cold-start kernel driver probe
Documentation and example usage for Private customers plus migration guide from legacy per-customer modules
tasks: Design Terraform module API and variable set; create README with examples for 'asg' and 'karpenter' modes
Implement ASG path: launch template, mixed instance policy, lifecycle hooks, and SSM documents for driver install
Implement Karpenter path: provisioner CR template generator, instance profile IAM role, and fallback settings
Add healthcheck mechanism: small Lambda + node agent or DaemonSet that runs NVML/CUDA probes and writes to monitoring and state bucket
Upgrade strategy: implement canary rollout variables, cordon/drain automation, and an opt-in automatic rollback on health regression
Integration tests: build Terraform test harness in CI (terragrunt/terratest) and add a smoke test job
Docs and runbook: create migration notes, troubleshooting section, and driver upgrade playbook for SREs
Security review: prepare module for KMS-encrypted AMI artifacts and e2e signing verification
